name: Hudson
description: Hudson was a street gang based in Chicago's Near North Side, formed by cousins and nephews of members of the Italian Little Hell Sharks after the expansion of Cabrini Green displaced Italian families from the Little Hell neighborhood. It was part of a second generation of successor gangs that also included the Mohawks and Cleveland Jammers. The three groups eventually united in the early 1970s under the CORP gang, representing the third generation of gangs descended from the original Little Hell Sharks.
